messages.title: Here's what's new in Shots Studio 1.9.70! 🚀
messages.message:
Thanks for updating to the latest version! 🎉

What's new:

 Features:
• You can now export collections as ZIP or copy to folders
• Backup & Restore your data so you can migrate devices or secure your library
• Personal notes in screenshot details for your own thoughts and links
• Explore Tesseract OCR as an AI provider if you don't need full AI suite

🐛 Bug Fixes:
• Fixed ghost photos in tag search
• Fixed Quick Collection from search
• Fixed collection screenshot count
• Fixed All Collections screen UI

Check out the changelogs for the full logs!

With ❤️,
Team Shots Studio

messages.title: We're officially on Google Play! 🚀✨
messages.message:
Big news! Thanks to your incredible support and feedback, Shots Studio has officially landed on the Google Play Store 🎉🎉!

 If you love the convenience of automatic updates, you can now find us there. Otherwise, feel free to keep rocking your current version, we'll keep supporting all the platforms!

(Note: If you do switch, remember to BACKUP your data in Settings first so you can restore it seamlessly!) 
 Settings > Advanced settings > Data Management > Backup 

Thank you for being part of this journey. We're just getting started! ❤️
